root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: knowledge of a thing, especially its real or hidden state, and softness, fertility, or abundance in land and related natural substances.
root_idea.development: The knowledge branch yields awareness, information, informing, inquiry, and reports; the softness-and-abundance branch yields soft ground, lush or water-holding land, cultivation, herbage, and various extensions involving abundance. The lexical tradition also records several specialized branches that remain distinct from these principles.

qac_form_accounting.reason: أَخْبَار is the regular plural of the supported dictionary noun خَبَر and is presented under that citation form.
Displayed under the normalized singular citation form خَبَر.
The Quranic adjective/noun is presented under the classical citation form خَبِير.
خُبْر is a distinct noun meaning knowledge or informed understanding.

senses.definition: A report, piece of information, or news; in the plural, reports or the circumstances and affairs reported about.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for information conveyed about a person, people, or matter. The Quranic plural أخبار may refer broadly to people's reported circumstances or affairs, not only to a single verbal announcement.

senses.definition: Knowledge or informed understanding of a matter, especially acquaintance with its real or internal state.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun of knowledge or experience; in Quranic usage it denotes knowledge gained or possessed concerning a matter, rather than a report as such.

senses.definition: Fully aware or knowing, particularly of the inner, real, or otherwise hidden qualities and circumstances of things.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran frequently uses the adjective as a divine attribute; it can also describe one possessing informed knowledge of matters, reports, or realities.

senses.definition: One who informs or makes known what has been learned.
senses.usage_conditions: A secondary Quran-focused interpretation of خبير as functionally equivalent to مُخْبِر, rather than the ordinary sense of one who is aware; it is associated with the divine disclosure of people's deeds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To know or possess knowledge of a thing, especially its internal or real state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical verbal usage; the forms and transitivity vary by attestation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To try, test, prove, or examine by trial or experience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applies to testing a person or thing in order to discover what it is or what one knows of it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To furrow or plough land for sowing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural use with the land as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make food greasy or add grease to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A culinary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land or a place, to become rich in lote-trees, soft ground, or related growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the condition of a tract rather than an act of knowing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to abound in milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of abundant milk production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contract with another to till and cultivate land for a determined share of its produce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A sharecropping or land-cultivation contract, traditionally described as a prohibited practice in the cited lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To inform, tell, acquaint, or make someone know a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be constructed with بِـ or عَنْ; it can also mean to state or predicate something about someone or something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find a milch camel abundant in milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized, figurative or tropical use distinct from informing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To buy a sheep or goat jointly, slaughter it, and divide its flesh among the purchasers according to their payments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized collective purchasing and division practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or seek information, news, or tidings; to inquire after news.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The inquiry may be directed to a person or pursued repeatedly and diligently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Trees such as lote and arak growing with abundant herbage around them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective natural-landscape noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seed-produce or the yield of seed-bearing plants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical or agricultural use distinct from news and knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where water rests or stagnates, including a water-furrow or hollow in mountain ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to a water-holding natural depression or channel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large leather water-bag.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is خُبُورٌ in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel abundant in milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative comparison with the large water-bag.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A transmitted report or tradition, especially in technical usage among traditionists.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Terminological distinctions vary: خَبَر may denote a report from someone other than the Prophet, or reports more generally, depending on the authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's state, condition, or case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical lexical use for the condition in which someone or something is found.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion or share of flesh or fish taken by someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A share of food, especially one assigned from a jointly divided quantity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat purchased by several people, slaughtered, and divided among them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Each participant receives a share proportioned to the amount paid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or flesh purchased for one's family.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A household-provision use, sometimes restricted in the cited discussion to meat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food consisting of flesh and other kinds of nourishment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general food sense broader than the specialized shared portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing brought forward or offered for entertainment or hospitality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of what people gather around and consume or enjoy together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large dish of crumbled or broken bread moistened with broth and made greasy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A prepared food, also described as a bread-and-meat dish.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bowl containing bread and meat for several people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A serving vessel or its communal contents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food carried and provided for oneself during travel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A travel provision or packed food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seasoning, condiment, or savoury food accompanying a meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A culinary accompaniment rather than the main bread or meat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A date, in a regional usage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectally reported lexical specialization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Trial, proof, test, or the experience gained through testing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can denote the process by which information is verified as well as resulting practical experience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A level tract rich in lote or arak trees, herbage, and retained water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A natural landscape noun for a lush or water-bearing tract, especially in a meadow's lower ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low or level place where water collects and stagnates, sometimes at the roots of trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a water-collecting depression, whether or not its vegetation is emphasized.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soft, crumbling ground in which animals' feet sink or become hindered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May include ground containing burrows and hollows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Heaps of earth or dust collected at the roots of trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A terrain feature associated with trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Burrows of large field-rats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective-noun use for such burrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An isolated lexical designation for the animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One possessing knowledge of God through acquaintance with His names and attributes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized religious use of the adjective, distinct from the general sense of being aware of things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lawyer or person skilled in law or practical religion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical designation of legal or religious expertise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A head or chief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tiller or cultivator of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural occupational designation, related in the lexical tradition to working and softening the soil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fur or soft hair, especially the hair of camels or the wild ass; also fallen hair or a portion of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material noun with animal-hair and detached-hair uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soft plants, fresh herbage, or seed-produce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative natural-material use, including herbage cut and eaten.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Froth or foam, especially the foam of camels' mouths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized physical-substance use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seasoned or made savoury.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A culinary adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Good wool from the first shearing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized textile or animal-product noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An invitation to the feast of a boy's عقيقة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social and ritual use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who tries, proves, or tests things; an experienced person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun emphasizing experience gained through trial.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant or tree with a bright, fragrant blossom used to adorn gardens.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical designation reported with uncertainty about its regional occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The black serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized animal name, also appearing in an imprecation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A notoriously dangerous or often fatal fever, in the expression “the fever of Khaybar.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression associated with a fever against which people warn one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A historian, formed as a relational adjective from the plural أخبار.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived designation for one concerned with reports or historical accounts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The internal or intrinsic state or quality of a thing, as opposed to its outward appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with appearance, aspect, or external form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A privy or place where excrement is voided.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person of good internal or intrinsic qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes inward character in contrast with outward appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Well seasoned or containing much grease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A culinary adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, having much flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, tentatively marked specialized use in the lexical source.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Illustrative phrase only; no additional lexical branch.
Inflectional and etymological pointer to خُبْر.

cautions: خَبَر and خُبْر are distinct vocalized nouns: the former centers on reported information or news, while the latter denotes knowledge or informed understanding.

The Quranic خَبِير entry is presented as the citation adjective even where QAC tags some occurrences nominally. Its second sense records a secondary lexical interpretation of the Quranic attribute as “one who informs.”
Several rare botanical, animal, culinary, dialectal, and technical extensions are retained as Classical Arabic meanings and should not be read as Quranic senses.
